25|
26|The candidate formalizes BrowserTask without replacing the existing Chromium ownership primitives:
27|

30|- Repeated creation for the same `taskId` is idempotent at the Chromium tab primitive and does not allocate a second live task page.

32|- Showing a different BrowserTask parks the previously visible BrowserTask semantically as well as physically.
33|- `destroyTask` is distinct from hide/park and explicitly removes the logical task and closes its owned page.
34|- Missing/crashed task pages may be recovered with exactly one replacement page while the logical task remains, recording `recoveryState: recreated`.

36|- Desktop process restart restores logical BrowserTask metadata as `parked` / `recoveryState: restored` before recreating any page. A page is created lazily only when the restored task is used again.

52|- Browser Hub task groupings such as active, waiting-for-human, background, and recent.

54|- Full versioned BrowserSessionState persistence/restoration for all logical tabs, active tab, ordering, and BrowserTask linkage.
